card.name: Words just before drug or treatment terms
card.fires_on: Small linking words, verbs or punctuation placed where a word like drug, medication, treatment or prescribing is likely to come next. It is seen in pharmacogenetics text, label cross-references and general health advice.

modes.label: Before drug responses
modes.description: A verb or possessive right before 'responses to drugs' in pharmacogenetics definitions.
modes.example: the study of how an individual's genetic makeup can<< affect>> one's responses to drugs.

modes.label: Label cross-references
modes.description: The period inside a Clinical Pharmacology section number in a bracketed reference.

modes.label: Before treatment or prescribing
modes.description: A linking word such as 'or', 'and' or 'to' just before treatment or prescribing in health advice.
modes.example: If you're looking for medical advice, a diagnosis,<< or>> treatment, consult your doctor
